description: Each Activity row carries title="<event.type>", so hovering anywhere on a row shows internal identifiers such as "task.update", "vein.resolve" or "comment.add".
expected: No tooltip on the row, or a human label ("Status change").
suggested_fix: Move the type to a data attribute.

description: Clicking a goal subject in Activity moves focus to the goal's <article tabindex=-1> on Goals, but the article has no visible focus style, so the user cannot see which goal was targeted.
expected: A brief highlight or focus outline on the target goal.
actual: No visual change on the focused article.
suggested_fix: Add :focus-visible / :focus styling (or a transient highlight) for goal articles.
